title: The Fed-Up Office Lady Wants to Serve the Villainess
titleRomaji: Genkai OL-san wa Akuyaku Reijou-sama ni Tsukaetai
titleEnglish: The Fed-Up Office Lady Wants to Serve the Villainess
titleNative: 限界OLさんは悪役令嬢さまに仕えたい
synopsis: Natori Midori has been giving it all at her hum-drum office job for three years now, only to have the rug pulled out from under her when she’s suddenly laid off. But just as she’s feeling lost and adrift, she is summoned to the world of the visual novel she’s currently playing, Fairy Tale of Jewels. And the person who summoned her there? None other than the game’s cruel villainess, Lapis Tenebrau, who’s trying to take down the main cast of the game. Driven into a corner, Natori pretends she’s psychic and uses her knowledge of the game to save Lapis from danger. Now Lapis has taken a shine to her, and is going to make Natori her private secretary?! Can Natori handle this new job, and her growing feelings for her villainess boss? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

synopsis: Nakamura Kano is an OL (office lady) with a secret… she’s a “Toku Otaku,” a tokusatsu otaku who is obsessed with live action dramas of heroes, monsters and robots. She thinks they’re “JUST TOO COOL!” She’s so obsessed that she skips out on drinking with colleagues to watch it on TV and collects the DVDs, books and figurines. She lives her life by the code of the tokusatsu heroes, and constantly imagines them to help her through difficult situations. But this isn’t easy when all of her co-workers think that people who like anime and other childish things are weird, and they keep trying to make her socialize. synopsis: "Please make me your disciple!!!" Souta, who was about to graduate from high school, felt frustrated that he hadn't become the kind of ideal delinquent he had always imagined. On his way home one day, a lame-looking office worker with a neatly parted hairstyle and glasses who had gotten into trouble with Souta's delinquent friends ended up completely defeating them! To his shock, that office worker turned out to be Morohoshi Keigo, the legendary delinquent Souta had always admired! From that day on, Souta starts visiting Morohoshi whenever he has free time, determined to become his apprentice. Why did he quit being a delinquent? Why is he pretending to be such a lame office worker? As Souta finds himself constantly thinking about Morohoshi, his feelings begin to change in an unexpected way...?! (Source: Cosmic Shuppan, translated) Note: Includes one extra chapter.
